upstream_audit.note: The pinned GraphTheory 0.9.7 and MathComp have no surface, rotation-system or genus notion (sgraph.v only mentions plane embeddings in a comment). The canonical is the existing public GTBase.surface.surface_embeddable, already audited LIGHTWEIGHT in meta/foundation_fidelity.json (module default: finite rotation systems, consumers must respect connectedness), so this family enrolls no fidelity fragment and adds no primitive. GTBase.surface.surface_embeddable_with_boundary has a different contract (an existential boundary set, audited BROKEN as vacuous) and is not a substitute for X164's ignored-boundary wrapper. Topological.foundations.embedding has a separate rotation record and genus formula under other names; a shared-ownership bridge would need a full record/face/genus comparison and is outside this family, as are face-orbit models, cops games and linear forests.
